picks.title: People don't want more AI
picks.excerpt: A counter-narrative arguing users are fatigued by AI features bolted onto every product, and what that backlash means for how designers should — and shouldn't — integrate AI into real experiences.
picks.rationale: Credible counter-narrative to AI-everywhere; directly changes where a designer chooses to add or withhold AI tomorrow.

picks.title: The best AI design tools of 2026, ranked
picks.excerpt: Designer channel Build Great Products ranks the major 2026 AI design tools — Figma, Anthropic's Claude Design and Google Stitch — testing each on the same brief to see which actually fits real product-design workflows.
picks.rationale: Hands-on head-to-head of Figma vs Claude Design vs Stitch on one brief — actionable tool-choice guidance for a designer's next project.

picks.title: AI systems are demanding new interaction models — are designers ready?
picks.excerpt: Argues generative AI is driving the first major shift in software interaction models in years, and asks whether designers are ready to invent the new patterns that go beyond chat boxes and prompts.
picks.rationale: Frames the concrete design work of inventing post-chat interaction patterns — a shift designers must start prototyping now.

picks.title: This optical-illusion font was created to baffle AI — and it actually works (for now)
picks.excerpt: A new optical-illusion typeface is engineered to be unreadable to AI/OCR systems while staying legible to humans — a craft-led designer pushback against machines scraping and reinterpreting visual work.
picks.rationale: Novel, tangible craft tool — a typeface designers can actually use to resist AI/OCR scraping; a fresh angle no prior card covered.

picks.title: AI has amplified my 20 years of experience, believes concept artist Daniel Porto
picks.excerpt: Veteran concept artist Daniel Porto argues AI has amplified rather than replaced his 20 years of craft, with creative vision and direction — not the tool — becoming the real competitive advantage in an AI-assisted workflow.
picks.rationale: Practitioner view from a working concept artist on folding AI into a craft pipeline — adds the 3D/render category for spread.
